title: The Long Afternoon
lessons: belonging can happen without performing it

text: Somebody else brought the cooler. Not my problem today.
Warm sand under the towel. Nothing on the calendar. I keep checking for the catch and there isn't one.
Okay. Whole afternoon. What do I actually want to do with it?

choices.text: Walk out into the water and just float for a while.
Go join whatever that game is by the shoreline.

text: Salt in my ears, sky doing nothing in particular.
I could stay out here a while. So I do.
I don't know half these people's names and nobody's asked for mine.
Someone lost count of the score twenty minutes ago. Nobody cared. That's why it works.
